import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int u, v, f, c;
        Edge(int u, int v, int f, int c) {
            this.u = u;
            this.v = v;
            this.f = f;
            this.c = c;
        }
    }

    static final long INF = 1000000009L;
    static int source, sink;
    static List<List<Integer>> adj;
    static List<Edge> edgeList;
    static int[] ptr = new int[1001];
    static int[] level = new int[1001];

    static void connect(int u, int v, int cap) {
        adj.get(u).add(edgeList.size());
        edgeList.add(new Edge(u, v, 0, cap));
        adj.get(v).add(edgeList.size());
        edgeList.add(new Edge(v, u, 0, 0));
    }

    static boolean buildLevelGraph() {
        Arrays.fill(level, -1);
        level[source] = 0;
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(source);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (int id : adj.get(u)) {
                Edge e = edgeList.get(id);
                if (level[e.v] == -1 && e.f < e.c) {
                    level[e.v] = level[u] + 1;
                    q.offer(e.v);
                    if (e.v == sink) return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static long pushFlow(int u, long flow) {
        if (u == sink || flow == 0) return flow;
        for (int i = ptr[u]; i < adj.get(u).size(); i++) {
            ptr[u] = i;
            int id = adj.get(u).get(i);
            Edge e = edgeList.get(id);
            if (level[e.v] != level[u] + 1) continue;
            long pushed = pushFlow(e.v, Math.min(flow, (long)e.c - e.f));
            if (pushed > 0) {
                e.f += pushed;
                edgeList.get(id ^ 1).f -= pushed;
                return pushed;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static long computeMaxFlow() {
        long total = 0;
        while (buildLevelGraph()) {
            Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
            long pushed;
            while ((pushed = pushFlow(source, INF)) > 0) {
                total += pushed;
            }
        }
        return total;
    }

    static String[] scientists = new String[101];
    static String[] reactors = new String[101];
    static boolean[][][][] pathExists = new boolean[10][10][10][10];
    static int[][] visitedCells = new int[101][101];
    static int[][] disableTime = new int[10][10];
    static int rows, cols;

    static boolean inside(int r, int c) {
        return r >= 0 && c >= 0 && r < rows && c < cols;
    }

    static int cellId(int r, int c) {
        return 1 + cols * r + c;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] firstLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        rows = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[0]);
        int T = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[1]);
        ++T;
        cols = rows;
        sink = cols * cols * 2 + 1;
        source = 0;
        adj = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < cols * cols * 2 + 2; i++) {
            adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
        edgeList = new ArrayList<>();
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        
        for (int i = 0; i < rows; i++) {
            scientists[i] = br.readLine();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < rows; i++) {
            reactors[i] = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < cols; j++) {
                disableTime[i][j] = (int)INF;
                if (reactors[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    q.offer(new int[]{i, j});
                    disableTime[i][j] = 1;
                }
            }
        }
        
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int x = cell[0];
            int y = cell[1];
            for (int di = -1; di <= 1; di++) {
                for (int dj = -1; dj <= 1; dj++) {
                    if (Math.abs(di) + Math.abs(dj) == 1) {
                        int nx = x + di;
                        int ny = y + dj;
                        if (inside(nx, ny) && disableTime[nx][ny] == (int)INF && scientists[nx].charAt(ny) != 'Y') {
                            disableTime[nx][ny] = disableTime[x][y] + 1;
                            q.offer(new int[]{nx, ny});
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int x = 0; x < rows; x++) {
            for (int y = 0; y < cols; y++) {
                char sc = scientists[x].charAt(y);
                if (sc >= '1' && sc <= '9') {
                    connect(source, cellId(x, y), sc - '0');
                }
                char rc = reactors[x].charAt(y);
                if (rc >= '1' && rc <= '9') {
                    connect(rows * rows + cellId(x, y), sink, rc - '0');
                }
                for (int X = 0; X < rows; X++) {
                    for (int Y = 0; Y < cols; Y++) {
                        if (scientists[x].charAt(y) == 'Y' || scientists[x].charAt(y) == 'Z' ||
                            reactors[X].charAt(Y) == 'Y' || reactors[X].charAt(Y) == 'Z') {
                            continue;
                        }
                        for (int i = 0; i < 101; i++) {
                            Arrays.fill(visitedCells[i], 0);
                        }
                        Queue<int[]> bq = new LinkedList<>();
                        bq.offer(new int[]{x, y, 1});
                        visitedCells[x][y] = 1;
                        boolean found = false;
                        while (!bq.isEmpty()) {
                            int[] curr = bq.poll();
                            int cx = curr[0];
                            int cy = curr[1];
                            int t = curr[2];
                            if (cx == X && cy == Y) {
                                visitedCells[cx][cy] = 1;
                                found = true;
                                break;
                            }
                            if (t >= disableTime[cx][cy] || t >= T) continue;
                            for (int di = -1; di <= 1; di++) {
                                for (int dj = -1; dj <= 1; dj++) {
                                    if (Math.abs(di) + Math.abs(dj) == 1) {
                                        int nx = cx + di;
                                        int ny = cy + dj;
                                        if (inside(nx, ny) && visitedCells[nx][ny] == 0 &&
                                            scientists[nx].charAt(ny) != 'Y' && scientists[nx].charAt(ny) != 'Z' &&
                                            t + 1 <= disableTime[nx][ny]) {
                                            visitedCells[nx][ny] = 1;
                                            bq.offer(new int[]{nx, ny, t + 1});
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        if (found) {
                            connect(cellId(x, y), rows * rows + cellId(X, Y), (int)INF);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(computeMaxFlow());
    }
}
